templates.title: openGym
templates.name: opengym
templates.description: openGym is a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker. It plans workouts, logs sets, and signs you in with passkeys. The web container proxies the API and serves exercise media.

env.name: NGINX_PORT
env.label: NGINX_PORT
env.description: Port nginx listens on inside the web container.

env.name: BACKEND
env.label: BACKEND
env.description: API service name that /api is proxied to.

env.name: PORT
env.label: PORT
env.description: Port the API listens on. The web container proxies to the same value.

env.name: RESOLVER
env.label: RESOLVER
env.description: Docker embedded DNS used by nginx.

env.name: CF_CONNECTING_IP
env.label: CF_CONNECTING_IP
env.description: Empty drops CF-Connecting-IP so a direct client cannot forge the logged address.

env.name: BASE_PATH
env.label: BASE_PATH
env.description: Empty serves the app at the site root.

env.name: MEDIA_UPLOAD_MAX
env.label: MEDIA_UPLOAD_MAX
env.description: Largest upload nginx passes to the API.

env.name: DATA_DIR
env.label: DATA_DIR
env.description: Accounts, passkeys, session secret, and uploads.

env.name: TRUST_PROXY
env.label: TRUST_PROXY
env.description: Trust forwarded headers from the web container, which overwrites them.

env.name: ORIGIN
env.label: ORIGIN
env.description: Full URL the app is served from. Must match the published host port.

env.name: RP_NAME
env.label: RP_NAME
env.description: Name shown in the passkey prompt.
